dataList.content: AAAHHHHHH! 啊啊啊啊啊！

No, no, no...! Meursault... My son...!
不行……！默尔索……！求你了！！！

It doesn't matter where I go—it's always there! It won't leave me. I'm never alone!
无论在哪我都没办法独自一人！没法独自一人啊！

I can't... I can't... Has it finally come for me, the final nothingness...?
啊啊……我要迎来终结了吗？

There's no running from this, Meursault... It's choking me...
逃也逃不掉，呼吸也做不到啊，默尔索……！
Meursault...! That gaze that watches me... it's... it's mine...! It's becoming mine, I'm being watched by my own gaze...! 默尔索……！我……我凝视着我自己。凝视起自己来了……！

Kill me, Meursault... You're my son... It's the least you can do for your maman... Meursault...
作为儿子，你该做的是……杀死……妈妈啊……默尔索……
Stop thinking about it, Meursault—just kill me! 别考虑了，默尔索！杀了我！

No more judgments, okay? Just... act. It's the... only way to... save... yourself...
不作判断地……行动吧。那样，才能保护你……

The creature stands awkwardly on its two feet, like an infant that had only just learned how to walk.
就像是刚刚学会走路一样，这个生物用双腿站立着。

It looked like it was crying, its gaping mouth a basin of crimson dark.
它看上去也像是在哭泣一般，其张开的口中仿佛积满了赤红的黑暗。

It was making sounds, but whether those sounds carried any meaning, I could not know.
虽然它能发出声音，但是否有意义就不清楚了。

Ah...
啊啊……

Hnnh... Hhh...
啊……啊啊……

<What... is it saying?>
<它在……说些什么？>

Sleep tight... My baby...
快快……安睡……我的宝贝……

... Undo... only the silkiest... threads...
只将漂亮的丝线……拆啊……拆开……

It's... it ain't speaking to us, is it...?
那家伙……对我们小声嘀咕些什么呢……？

<I think it's singing...>
<它好像在唱歌……>

It's a lullaby, Manager.
是摇篮曲，执行经理。

The content and rhythm suggest a high degree of similarity to what those outside the Grand Magasin call a "lullaby."
其形式与外面被称作摇篮曲的歌词十分相似。
